estimation_note: Token counts are estimates using the char_heuristic method (chars / 3.8 for prose, chars / 3.5 for JSON). Actual server-side tokenisation may differ by ±5–8%. Estimates use conservative (high) bias to trigger alerts before true limits are reached.

system_prompt.notes: Verbose system prompt including role definition, personality, tool-use rules, escalation policy, compliance notes, and response formatting rules. Well within normal range for a customer service agent prompt.

tool_schemas.insight: Tool schemas represent the dominant fixed cost at 6.17% of the 200K window. On a 16K model this would consume 77% of available context before any conversation begins — the primary illustration of the silent context tax.

conversation_history.notes: 15-turn session including 8 tool call/result pairs. Tool results contribute approximately 40% of conversation token cost. Session is 18 minutes old.

injected_files.notes: No files injected into context for this session. Would increase significantly if billing PDFs or knowledge base articles were loaded inline.

threshold_evaluation.estimated_turns_until_warn: ~370 additional turns at current average turn size (332 tokens/turn)

growth_projection.projection_note: Based on current session average. Tool-heavy turns (with large CRM results) can be 3–5x average. Projections are approximate.

16k_window.warning: On a 16K model, only 2,393 tokens remain for conversation after fixed costs — this session would already be at risk of context overflow.

notes: Session is healthy. No action required at this time.
Tool schema tax (12,340 tokens across 8 tools) is the largest single cost category and cannot be reduced without unloading tools.
If session continues beyond ~200 turns with tool-heavy exchanges, a warn-level alert is projected around turn 370.
Recommend invoking ContextProfiler again if any large files (billing PDFs, KB articles) are injected into context.
